failure: Failure: Scope is finite-state and reversible, with C-infinity regularity near equilibrium and independent uninformative augmentation. It does not classify nonsmooth functionals, nonreversible relaxation, empirical or quantum dynamics, or Polish-space divergences. The exact example calculation is source-reported only; no formal proof-assistant verification or external correctness review is supplied.
interface: Interface: Finite-state distributions only. Each fixed q has continuity throughout the open simplex and C-infinity regularity in a neighborhood of q; no analyticity, nondegenerate Hessian or differentiability in q is assumed. Independent augmentation identities are explicitly required in both tensor orders; full tensor additivity is not assumed. Complete monotonicity means (-1)^k d^k/dt^k D_n(p exp(tL),q)>=0 for every integer k>=0 and t>0, for every irreducible q-reversible generator. The result does not cover nonreversible generators or a no-smoothness setting.

claims.title: Complete monotonicity under reversible Markov dynamics classifies positive entire chi-square profiles
